header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.text:
Explanation:- “Aden' is a well-known city in the land of Yemen, and “Amman” is the name of a city in Jordan. The words “Aden' and “Amman' have been used in this hadith as a point of reference. Its meaning is that the length and breadth of the “Hawd” in the Hereafter will be as great as the distance between “Aden' and “Amman' in this world. But it does not mean that the area of the “Hawd' will be limited to only this much distance; rather, it has been mentioned in this way to explain that the length and breadth of the “Hawd' will extend over a distance of many hundreds of miles.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا تَكُوْنُوْا اِمَّعَةً تَقُوْلُوْنَ: اِنْ اَحْسَنَ النَّاسُ اَحْسَنَّا، وَاِنْ ظَلَمُوْا ظَلَمْنَا، وَلكِنْ وَطِّنُوْا اَنْفُسَكُمْ اِنْ اَحَسْنَ النَّاسُ اَنْ تُحْسِنُوْا، وَاِنْ اَسَاءُوْا فَلَا تَظْلِمُوْا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاء في الاحسان والعفو رقم :٢٠٠٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Do not look at the ways of others and behave just like them. Do not say, “If people do good to us, we will do good to them, and if people wrong us, we will wrong them.' Rather, establish yourselves firmly upon this quality: “If people do good to you, you also do good; and even if people behave badly, you do not commit wrong.'”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ اَنَّهَا قَالَتْ: مَاانْتَقَمَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ لِنَفْسِهِ فِيْ شَيْءٍ قَطُّ اِلَّا اَنْ تُنْتَهَكَ حُرْمَةُ اللهِ فَيَنْتَقِمُ بِهَا لِلّهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه البخاري باب قول النبي ﷺ: يسروا ولاتعسروا ...رقم:٦١٢٦
